description: This file defines the base exception class for PySpark errors, along with numerous specific exception subclasses, query context classes, and utility functions related to error handling within the PySpark project.

classes.name: PySparkException
classes.description: Base class for all PySpark-related exceptions, providing methods for error details and logging.

classes.name: AnalysisException
classes.description: Indicates failure to analyze a SQL query plan.

classes.name: SessionNotSameException
classes.description: Indicates an operation was performed on different SparkSessions.

classes.name: TempTableAlreadyExistsException
classes.description: Indicates failure to create a temporary view because it already exists.

classes.name: ParseException
classes.description: Indicates failure to parse a SQL command.

classes.name: IllegalArgumentException
classes.description: Indicates an illegal or inappropriate argument was passed.

classes.name: ArithmeticException
classes.description: Represents an arithmetic error thrown from Spark.

classes.name: UnsupportedOperationException
classes.description: Indicates an unsupported operation in Spark.

classes.name: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
classes.description: Indicates an array index out of bounds error.

classes.name: DateTimeException
classes.description: Represents a datetime-related error.

classes.name: NumberFormatException
classes.description: Indicates a number format error.

classes.name: StreamingQueryException
classes.description: Indicates a streaming query was stopped due to an exception.

classes.name: StreamingPythonRunnerInitializationException
classes.description: Indicates failure to initialize a streaming Python runner.

classes.name: QueryExecutionException
classes.description: Indicates failure to execute a query.

classes.name: PythonException
classes.description: Exceptions thrown from Python workers.

classes.name: SparkRuntimeException
classes.description: Represents a runtime exception from Spark.

classes.name: SparkUpgradeException
classes.description: Indicates an exception due to Spark upgrade.

classes.name: SparkNoSuchElementException
classes.description: Indicates a 'NoSuchElement' exception in Spark.

classes.name: UnknownException
classes.description: Represents an unspecified or unknown error.

classes.name: PySparkValueError
classes.description: Wrapper for ValueError supporting error classes.

classes.name: PySparkTypeError
classes.description: Wrapper for TypeError supporting error classes.

classes.name: PySparkIndexError
classes.description: Wrapper for IndexError supporting error classes.

classes.name: PySparkAttributeError
classes.description: Wrapper for AttributeError supporting error classes.

classes.name: PySparkRuntimeError
classes.description: Wrapper for RuntimeError supporting error classes.

classes.name: PySparkAssertionError
classes.description: Wrapper for AssertionError supporting error classes, with additional data attribute.

classes.name: PySparkNotImplementedError
classes.description: Wrapper for NotImplementedError supporting error classes.

classes.name: PySparkPicklingError
classes.description: Wrapper for pickle.PicklingError supporting error classes.

classes.name: PySparkKeyError
classes.description: Wrapper for KeyError supporting error classes.

classes.name: PySparkImportError
classes.description: Wrapper for ImportError supporting error classes.

classes.name: PickleException
classes.description: Represents an error during server-side pickling, distinct from Python's PicklingError.

classes.name: QueryContextType
classes.description: Enum representing the type of query context (SQL or DataFrame).

classes.name: QueryContext
classes.description: Abstract base class for query context information, helping locate error sources.

methods.name: recover_python_exception
methods.description: Utility function to recover and parse Python exception stack traces wrapped in JVM exceptions.
